facts.claim: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Drafting Committee appointed on 29 August 1947 had seven original members: B. R. Ambedkar, N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar, Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar, K. M. Munshi, Syed Mohammad Saadulla, B. L. Mitter and D. P. Khaitan. N. Madhava Rau later replaced Mitter, and T. T. Krishnamachari replaced Khaitan after his death. Rau did not replace Alladi, making statement 3 false.
